subject.title: [Feature Request] Code Verification and Signature for Skills

question: What trust model should OpenClaw enforce for SKILL.md skills before prompt loading and capability use?
rationale: The choice affects publisher or registry trust roots, revocation, unsigned-skill compatibility, persisted metadata, ClawHub policy, and capability enforcement, so automation cannot safely choose it from source inspection alone.

options.title: Design Canonical Signed-Skill Model
options.body: Define signatures, persisted expected content, runtime reverify, status surfaces, revocation behavior, and unsigned migration policy before implementation.

options.title: Keep Verification Advisory For Now
options.body: Treat current ClawHub verification and local hashes as operator information only until a broader security profile lands.

options.title: Enforce Unsigned Restrictions Immediately
options.body: Require verified signatures for full capability access and degrade or reject unsigned skills with explicit upgrade and override behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Canonical Signed-Skill Model
recommendation.body: Define signatures, persisted expected content, runtime reverify, status surfaces, revocation behavior, and unsigned migration policy before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history across native ClawHub skill install behavior, current loader ownership, and prior security-product reviews of this issue family.
